questions.q: Where, according to the writer, does a person feel "at home"?
o: Where he has a good command of the language
questions.e: In the video: "mesto gde se najviše osećaš domaći je tamo gde dobro vladaš jezikom" — the place where you feel most at home is where you have a good command of the language.

questions.q: How did he start translating?
o: Reading Saramago in Portuguese, he "translated in his head" and decided to write the translation down on the computer
He studied to become a translator
questions.e: In the video: "da bih je pročitao, treba da je praktično prevedem u glavi. I onda sam ja, umesto da prevodim u glavi, seo za kompjuter i svaku rečenicu lepo preveo" — to read it, I practically have to translate it in my head. And then, instead of translating in my head, I sat down at the computer and nicely translated every sentence.

questions.q: Which Andrić book did he translate seven years after Saramago?
questions.e: In the video: "Nekih sedam godina potom sam uzeo „Prokletu avliju“ i rekao: ajde sada da probam ovo" — some seven years later I picked up "Prokleta avlija" and said: let me try this now.

questions.q: How, as he noticed later, are his books connected with each other?
o: The theme of the identity of "displaced" people and immigrants
questions.e: In the video: "jedino i bavim identitetom izmeštenih ljudi.... uglavnom neki imigranti" — the only thing I deal with is the identity of displaced people... mostly immigrants.

questions.q: Why did he go to London in 1989?
o: For a summer internship at the height of the construction boom under Thatcher
questions.e: In the video: "otišao sam za London... na neku praksu preko leta, jer je u to vreme bio neki veliki procvat pod Tačerkom" — I went to London... for some internship over the summer, because at that time there was a big boom under Thatcher.

questions.q: How did he solve the problem with documents in London?
o: He married for the papers — and stayed best friends with his wife
questions.e: In the video: "Ja sam rešio svoj problem u Londonu tako što sam se oženio... To je bilo za papire. Dan-danas smo najbolji drugari" — I solved my problem in London by getting married... That was for the papers. To this day we are best friends.

questions.q: How did he contact José Saramago after the bombing of Serbia?
o: Called him and asked him to speak out against it; he did
questions.e: In the video: "počelo bombardovanje Srbije. I onda sam ga ja lepo pozvao telefonom i zamolio ga da se on izjasni protiv toga, što je on i" — the bombing of Serbia began. And then I nicely called him by phone and asked him to speak out against it, which he did.

questions.q: Why can't one live professionally from literature in Serbia?
questions.e: In the video: "U Srbiji... nemoguće je baviti se profesionalno književnošću... nema dovoljno čitalaca" — in Serbia... it's impossible to practice literature professionally... there aren't enough readers.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Gde dobro *vladaš* jezikom, tu se osećaš domaći.
questions.e: Vladati jezikom — to have a command of a language.

questions.q: Dobro vladam sa tri jezika, a još dva *natucam*.
questions.e: Natucati — to know a little, to get by somehow.

questions.q: Bavim se identitetom *izmeštenih* ljudi.
questions.e: Izmešten — displaced, deprived of one's home place.

questions.q: Mi jesmo bili *izbeglice*.
questions.e: Izbeglica — a refugee.

questions.q: Plašio sam se policije, da me ne uhvate i ne *proteraju*.
questions.e: Proterati — to expel, to drive out.

questions.q: Mi smo svi *privređivali*, niko nije bio na socijalnoj pomoći.
questions.e: Privređivati — to earn, to run a household economy.

questions.q: Vinogradarsko imanje koje je imao moj pokojni *tast*.
questions.e: Tast — a father-in-law (the wife's father).

questions.q: Nikome ne moram da se *dodvoravam*.
questions.e: Dodvoravati se — to curry favor, to suck up.

questions.q: Nisam imao nameru da se bavim ___.
questions.e: Baviti se with what — instrumental case: prevođenjem.

questions.q: Seo sam za ___ i svaku rečenicu lepo preveo.
questions.e: Sesti za + accusative case; for inanimate nouns it coincides with the nominative: za kompjuter.

questions.q: Kad mi je prva Saramagova knjiga dopala u ___.
questions.e: Dopasti u ruke — "to fall into one's hands"; accusative plural: ruke.

questions.q: Prve su mi bile „Priče iz ___“.
questions.e: Iz ("from") requires the genitive case: iz Lisabona.

questions.q: Odavde sam otišao za ___ 1989. godine.
questions.e: Ići za + a city in the accusative case; for inanimate nouns it coincides with the nominative: za London.

questions.q: Pročitao sam sedamnaest telefonskih ___ materijala.
questions.e: After the number 17 the genitive plural is used: imenika.

questions.q: Moj susret sa ___ dogodio se tako što sam preveo njegovu knjigu.
questions.e: Sa ("with") requires the instrumental case: sa Saramagom.

questions.q: Moja publika je najviše 25 ___.
questions.e: After the number 25 the genitive plural is used: miliona.
